snapshot.title: Hospital Water Safety Query — Millbrook General Hospital

fields.subject: Hospital (Millbrook General Hospital) — Water safety officer requests confirmation on dialysis safety under low pressure
fields.description: Hospital (Millbrook General Hospital, Oak Street) — Water safety officer reports sustained low pressure (15 psi) and requests confirmation on whether the hospital’s water is safe for dialysis. The facility is running on backup bottled water. They are not asking for an advisory but need confirmation for internal safety protocols. Contact: (555) 038-8800.

activity.author: Customer Service Lead (Renee Dupree)
activity.text: Ticket created from direct phone call from Millbrook General Hospital water safety officer. Hospital confirms no visible break, but pressure has been below 20 psi for 45 minutes. They are not requesting an advisory but need confirmation for dialysis safety protocols. This is a Zone 1 facility per C1 and C4.
